summary: Regression + accessibility retest after palette/CTA refresh. Backend pytest 5/5 pass (health stubbed, create/list enquiries, 422 validations, no _id leak). Frontend: all required home sections render (hero, intro, trust-points x4, gallery, featured-projects x6, why-us, process, editorial-marquee, faq-section w/ accordion expand, testimonials, final-cta). Amber gold CTAs verified — hero-cta, nav-cta, final-cta-btn, submit-enquiry all carry class btn-gold with computed background rgb(197,137,45) and text rgb(11,27,46). Accessibility body-copy contrast landed: intro-section paragraph color rgb(30,41,59)=#1E293B, featured project description rgb(71,85,105)=#475569 — both darker than #6B7280. Section-heading contrast: why-us navy on off-white; process-section off-white on navy — correct. About page /about with about-cta OK, /services/kitchen-renovations shows service-kitchen-renovations. Contact form fill+submit produced [data-testid=thanks] with 'Thank you — we’ll be in touch soon.' state.
critical_code_review_comments: Palette variables in index.css cleanly reflect apollobuilders.com.au — navy #0B1B2E, off-white #F7F5F1, gold #C5892D. Good token discipline.
Body copy standardised on --ink (#1E293B) and --ink-soft (#475569) which are both above WCAG AA on the warm off-white background.
Signature amber CTA (btn-gold) applied to all primary calls to action (nav, hero, final, submit-enquiry) — matches live site behavior.
No regressions detected in server.py contract; _id still excluded.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_ prefixed enquiries via API (test_john) and UI form submission (TEST_Playwright User).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py, run via `pytest backend/tests/test_api.py`. Preview URL: https://premium-apollo.preview.emergentagent.com. Featured project testids follow pattern `project-{slug}` (not `project-premium-apollo-{slug}` as review prompt hinted — that string was the preview subdomain name). Contact form inputs are `input-name/phone/email/address/project-type/message` and success surfaces at data-testid=`thanks`.
